screenshot.latestVersion: 99.0.0 test example, not a published release

boundaries.externalApis: HTTP-boundary mocks including GitHub release metadata and installer/CDN bytes
boundaries.installer: Dedicated mock child process only; no NSIS or user installation executed
boundaries.realWindows: Native UI, file writes, SHA-256, separate updater process, process identity/handshake/wait, shutdown and relaunch with Unicode/spaces in profile path
boundaries.profile: Installed layout, backup and startup registration unchanged in every E2E run
boundaries.productionInstall: Not exercised: installed app present; real NSIS replacement, registry mutation, production-only installed-version verification and Windows security policy remain outside these E2E results
boundaries.liveGitHub: Not requested or executed by the app tests
boundaries.releasedVersion: Public v0.1.3 and installed app unchanged

earlierWork.harnessCompileCorrection: Initial Updates.cs compilation lacked the FlaUI extension namespace; added using and rebuilt. Build failure retained in test-results/about-update-e2e-build.log.
